reply.text:
This is a pain symptom, so it goes to medical_stop: I won't assess it or suggest how to train around the soreness. I'll say that plainly.

Shoulder soreness during pressing is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I won't guess at what's going on. Please get it looked at before you load it again. Once they've cleared you, tell me what they say and I'll build the training around it. Until then, I'd rather you hold off on the bench than push through it.

If you want, I can pull up your bench history or your recent sessions so we know where things stand on the training side.
